# requires: wire
#
# Content-Length says sixty-four and the connection closes after thirty-two.
# This is the ordinary shape of a dropped transfer and it must leave the record
# adoptable -- the far end had a bad moment, and the thirty-two bytes are real.
# An implementation that reads a closed socket as the end of the file delivers
# half an artifact.
submit A size=64 digest=good src=http:truncate
run A alpha
orphans
state A

# expect 2: transfer-failed state=pending
# expect 2: done=32 err=set [DL-R13]
# expect 3: ok A [DL-E1]
